framework.q: Who owns this, and who answers for it?
framework.hint: Q1 is who is accountable; Q4 is whether one person could act alone.

framework.q: Did we do the research before we took it on?
framework.hint: Q2 is checks before you take something on; Q7 is checks while it runs.

framework.q: Does anyone hold more access than the job needs?
framework.hint: Q3 is how much access; Q4 is whether one person can complete the act alone.

framework.q: Can one person do this alone?
framework.hint: Q4 is a second person on the same act; Q7 is someone checking after.

framework.q: Is it locked by default, and does it fail closed?
framework.hint: Q5 is the state before anyone acts; Q6 is what stands behind a failed layer.

framework.q: If this layer fails, what stands behind it?
framework.hint: Q6 is a second layer; Q5 is the default setting of one layer.

framework.q: Even when we trust it, who verifies?
framework.hint: Q7 is checking work that is trusted; Q2 is research before the work starts.

framework.q: Whose control is this: ours or the provider's?
framework.hint: Q8 is who holds the control; Q1 is who answers when it fails.

stop.means: Place a control (a check, a verification, a revoked account, a block, a second pair of eyes) on the actor who was placed to apply it.
